title: Harbor Island National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Harbor Island National Wildlife Refuge consists of two islands, Harbor and Standerson Islands. These islands are in Potagannissing Bay, Lake Huron, near Drummond Island on the eastern end of the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. They are 3.5 miles south of the Canada border.
